branches.conclusion: The faculty doctoral procedure and previously read institute inventory establish an individually supervised Dr. rer. pol. route but no formally named Operations or Management Science doctoral field or qualifying department. The 2026 Operation Management chair vacancy invites doctoral research under a chair; it does not name a separate doctoral programme or specialization. The current university structured-programme inventory has no matching business title.

The official faculties and doctoral-regulations frame has no standalone engineering faculty. Technical doctorates are administered in Mathematics and Computer Science; its actual institutes, departments and professorships are checked in the dated 2026 organization chart.

The Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science doctoral process is individually supervised in a faculty teaching/research subject. Its 1 April 2026 complete institute/department/professorship chart names Mathematical Optimization and several computing groups but no formal Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering unit; the university's full structured-doctoral programme list also has no corresponding exact title. Optimization as a professorship or thesis topic is not reclassified as a named eligible field.
